title: Order is assessed against strategy: a domain defines the tensions, a working group holds the strategy (2026-10-27)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Ordering should be assessed against a strategic priority. This is part of the working group's reason for existence. A domain defines the tensions, and a working group holds our strategy for approaching it.

sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-27; recorded verbatim. Context: Claude Code had reviewed the programme of works (068a0a8b) and asked whether clerk#124 should move earlier in its order.
